# `regional_targets`

**Layer:** **synthetic** — generated by `scripts/synth/generate.py` for demonstration. Every answer that reads this table must say so (`V2-SYN-4`). Dates span 2016-09-01 to 2018-10-31.

Monthly revenue target per state.

**Grain:** state x month.

## Columns

| Column | Meaning | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | Real customer state code. | text |
| `month` | YYYY-MM. | month |
| `revenue_target` | Target revenue. | BRL |

## Join keys

- `regional_targets.state = customers.customer_state`, `month` = purchase month

## Caveats

- Target attainment divides **real** revenue by this **synthetic** target, so it is complete only when both are (last complete month 2018-08).
